mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO below 100.0), production constraints reduce corporate margins and equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not negative when INDPRO < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of employment (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month average signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% and rise in UNRATE above 4.5% signals a stagflationary environment that reduces corporate profit margins and equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and UNRATE > 4.5 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST above 1500.0), increased residential construction activity boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not positive when HOUST > 1500.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
